dhp266:3: The correct reading here may be _visamaṁ_, which would give the meaning of “flawed, distorted, unstable, non-peaceful, non-harmonious” or similar. The reading given here, _vissaṁ_, can have a sense of “putrid, foul, rotten” which may also be relevant to the intended meaning.
dhp272:2: _Aputhujjana_ (lit. “uncommon”) is usually understand to mean people who have attained some stage of awakening.
